regions.today: Warm dry and sunny. Highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees, cooler near coasts in a light sea breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry and mild tonight with clear skies. Slight risk of mist. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees, with light winds.
regions.tomorrow: Another dry and very warm day with long spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 23 to 27 or 28 degrees, slightly cooler near coasts, with a light to moderate northeasterly breeze.
